description: This is a Java source file defining a class 'PersistableOrderPopulator' responsible for converting 'PersistableOrder' objects into 'Order' objects within an e-commerce system. It manages data mappings, references to external services, and populates order details such as customer info, order items, and totals.

classes.name: PersistableOrderPopulator
classes.description: A class that converts 'PersistableOrder' data transfer objects into 'Order' domain objects, handling data mapping, validation, and integrating with various external services to populate order details.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Transforms a 'PersistableOrder' into an 'Order' object by mapping fields, validating data, and invoking external services to retrieve related information like customer, currency, and zone details.

methods.description: Method intended to create a new 'Order' instance, currently returns null and may be overridden or implemented in subclasses.
